1.mascotDialogue: One rule, no exceptions, capito? Everything happens at the top! You want to touch anywhere else — mamma mia, you do not want a stack, tesoro.

2.mascotDialogue: `top`, she is the stack's whole memory of where she stands! Minus one, empty. MAX minus one, full. Everything else, it is just that one number, moving back and forth.

3.mascotDialogue: Look — the TOP marker, sitting on index 2, with two empty spaces still above her! That room to grow, that is the whole point.

4.mascotDialogue: The function, she did her job — she said no! The fault, it belongs entirely to the caller, who did not listen. That is why we always show the broken state honestly, a slot past capacity, right there for you to see — never quietly, never in secret.
